question: Which of the following is a sports term popularly used in Athletics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Photo finish.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Photo Finish**

 
 
• In a sporting race, a photo finish occurs when **multiple competitors cross** the finish line nearly simultaneously.
 
• A** photo or video** taken at the finish line can be used for a more **precise check **because it may not be possible to see which competitor crossed the line first.
 
• Officials are less likely to declare a race a **dead heat** when photo finishes are used.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Athletics**

 
 
• The competitive sports of running, jumping, throwing, and walking are known as athletics. **Track and field**, road running, cross-country running, and racewalking are the most common athletics competitions.
 
• The athlete with the **highest or furthest measurement** from a series of attempts wins the jumps and throws, respectively, in racing events determined by** finishing position** (or time, depending on the event).
 
• The **Ancient Olympic Games**, which took place in **776 BC,** are the earliest example of organized athletics.
